layers.description: Single-script PowerShell 5.1 monolith: -Action dispatcher (switch ~L3600), staged download-verify-commit pipeline, NSSM services, watchdog, i18n.
layers.name: Installer Core

layers.description: Maintainer-only tooling keeping the pinned manifest and the embedded fallback inside the installer in sync.
layers.name: Manifest Tooling

layers.description: Static assets-only channel on dl.* custom domain: no Worker script, build-generated public/ with integrity files and landing page.
layers.name: Distribution

nodes.name: installer.ps1
nodes.summary: Sole entry point and runtime: -Action dispatcher switch (~L3600, Install/Update/Pause/Resume/Restart/Uninstall/Status/SetUpstream/SetDns/Menu), staged 2-phase install with rollback, NSSM services, watchdog task, i18n T(). 113 functions, ~199KB, PS 5.1 monolith.

nodes.name: approved-releases.json
nodes.summary: Source of truth for pinned versions + SHA-256 (schema:1, policy:approved-only). Pins installer 1.2.0, dnsproxy v0.86.0, zapret v72.13, nssm 2.24.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm scripts wiring Pester tests and Cloudflare build/deploy; devDependency wrangler 4.147.0.

nodes.name: tools/Update-Manifest.ps1
nodes.summary: Maintainer-only: regenerates approved-releases.json (canonical JSON, UTF-8 no-BOM, CRLF) and patches the embedded fallback block inside installer.ps1 via exact single-occurrence replace. Params -DnsproxyTag/-ZapretTag/-NssmVersion/-NssmUrl/-SkipDownload.

nodes.name: cloudflare/wrangler.toml
nodes.summary: Source of truth for worker name/route/compatibility_date; assets-only (./public), workers_dev=false, custom domain dl.taiyuanwangjie.dpdns.org. Mirrored by wrangler.config.ts and cloudflare.config.ts.

nodes.name: cloudflare/build.sh
nodes.summary: Sole generator of cloudflare/public/: copies installer+manifest+landing, normalizes to CRLF for deterministic hashes, writes _headers/version.json/SHA256SUMS, enforces installer-vs-manifest version parity gate.

nodes.name: cloudflare/landing.html
nodes.summary: Single static landing page (inline CSS + vanilla JS, no build): VI/EN toggle, copy buttons, version badge from /version.json, reduced-motion-aware canvas. Built to public/index.html.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: User-facing docs: install/usage actions and switches, config files, update/uninstall flows, troubleshooting, trust model, dev tasks, release process.

nodes.name: tests/Installer.Logic.Tests.ps1
nodes.summary: Pester unit/mocked suite for installer logic (runs via npm test / Invoke-Pester ./tests).

nodes.name: tests/Installer.Maintain.Tests.ps1
nodes.summary: Pester maintain/parity suite (config parity, version gates) for the installer repo.

nodes.name: Get-ApprovedManifest (~L704)
nodes.summary: Fetches manifest from project endpoint, falls back to raw GitHub, then to embedded copy (warns). Caches in $script:ManifestCache; throws on schema/policy or installer-version mismatch.

nodes.name: Verify-Sha256 (~L770)
nodes.summary: Streaming SHA-256 check: validates 64-hex expected value, hashes file without full in-memory load, throws on mismatch with size/actual diagnostics.

nodes.name: Install-StageComponents (~L1580)
nodes.summary: Phase 1: downloads dnsproxy/zapret/NSSM assets per manifest into admin-only staging, Verify-Sha256 each, extracts and validates (dnsproxy.exe, x64 winws.exe bundle, win64 nssm.exe), returns stage paths.

nodes.name: Install-CommitComponents (~L1723)
nodes.summary: Phase 2: snapshots rollback copies, swaps staged binaries into C:\serverless-edge-dns-gateway, handles locked WinDivert64.sys (identical-kept, differing→reboot error), preserves user files, rolls back on failure.

nodes.name: Write-WatchdogFile (~L2259)
nodes.summary: Generates standalone watchdog script (never dot-sources installer): per-minute DNS health check, restarts stopped gateway services, 3-fail DHCP fail-open (or sticky with -FailClosed), covers new adapters.

nodes.name: manifest-pinning
nodes.summary: approved-only policy: every component pinned by tag/asset/sha256 in approved-releases.json; remote fetch with embedded fallback; Update-Manifest.ps1 keeps both copies in sync.

nodes.name: staged-commit
nodes.summary: Two-phase install: download→verify→stage into admin-only dir, then commit with rollback snapshot; locked kernel driver handled safely via reboot instead of forced delete.

nodes.name: assets-only-deploy
nodes.summary: Cloudflare channel serves only static assets (installer, manifest, integrity files, landing) on dl.*; no Worker script, headers via _headers file; binaries always come from pinned upstreams.

project.description: Automatic Windows installer and manager for a local DNS (dnsproxy) + DPI-bypass routing (zapret/winws) gateway, managed via NSSM services + watchdog scheduled task. Single PowerShell monolith with pinned manifest, static Cloudflare distribution.
project.name: sedgwz-auto-installer

tour.description: Start here: one -Action parameter drives everything (Install/Update/Status/Restart/Uninstall/Pause/Resume/SetUpstream/SetDns/Menu). Default action is the interactive menu; irm|iex works via self-path fallback.
tour.title: Single entry point

tour.description: No floating versions: approved-releases.json pins every component by tag and SHA-256. The installer refuses to proceed on schema/policy or version mismatch.
tour.title: Trust starts at the manifest

tour.description: Downloads land in an admin-only staging dir and each archive is hash-verified before extraction. Nothing unverified ever touches the live install path.
tour.title: Stage and verify before touching anything live

tour.description: Only after all validation succeeds are binaries swapped in, with a rollback snapshot and safe handling of the locked WinDivert driver (reboot, never forced delete).
tour.title: Commit with rollback

tour.description: A generated standalone script runs every minute: restarts stopped gateway services, re-applies local DNS to new adapters, fails open to DHCP after 3 failures (or stays with -FailClosed).
tour.title: Watchdog keeps DNS alive

tour.description: build.sh publishes installer + manifest + integrity files + landing page as static assets on dl.*; binaries always come from pinned upstreams, never this host. Bump versions with Update-Manifest.ps1, verify with Pester.
tour.title: Ship it and maintain it
